title: Going Back to Study
sentences: After eleven years at work, I decided to go back to college and finish a degree.
I had thought about doing it for a long time before I finally applied.
The hardest part was admitting that I had completely forgotten how to study.
I felt lost for most of the first month.
Most of the other students were about ten years younger than I was.
They were quicker with the reading, but I asked better questions in class.
Experience, my tutor said, counts for more than speed.
I now study for two hours every evening, even on days when I am tired.
My marks are not brilliant, but they have improved a little every term.
If I finish next year, I will be the first person in my family to do so.
